source_policy: Shared agreement ledger: all signed player salaries, options and guarantees use the same dated terms as Player Impact. Team payroll is recomputed, with two-way salaries excluded from cap charges. Cap holds, dead money and override-only rights retain their dated source.
notes: All current signed player contracts use the complete dated agreement ledger. Cap holds and dead-money source rows remain separately identified as retained estimates.
Season years use NBA season end year: 2027 is 2026-27, 2028 is 2027-28, and so on.
The Spotrac-powered tracker starts at 2026-27 and intentionally drops the prior 2025-26 tracker season.
Guarantee percentages are hover-only on Spotrac and are not captured at scale in v1.
Displayed player pay and known options use the complete shared signed-agreement ledger.
Manual guarantee, pick, and exception override CSVs remain available for targeted additions.
